A friendly CARICATURE of the historical scientist Archimedes: head about 1.6x oversized, exaggerated but kind and instantly recognisable features from well-known historical portraits (hair, face shape, moustache, clothing of their era), expressive. Full body, standing, ancient Greek, curly beard, simple tunic, sandals, drawing a circle in the sand with a stick, holding a lever. Adult, dignified-comic, not childish. One figure only, feet visible, no text, no letters, no logo. Flat solid pure green #00FF00 background, no shadow on the background, no green on the figure.
